sloka: अन्योन्य बद्ध वैराणाम् जिगीषूणाम् नृपात्मज ।उद्योग समयः सौम्य पार्थिवानाम् उपस्थितः ॥४-३०-५९॥
transliteration: anyonya baddha vairāṇām jigīṣūṇām nṛpātmaja ।udyoga samayaḥ saumya pārthivānām upasthitaḥ ॥4-30-59॥

translations.english: 'O gentle Lakshmana the pure water in the tanks and sweet sounds of flocks of female kurari birds and chakravakas there are splendid.
